exercises.exercise_description: A 30° or 45° bench will work here. Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Use a 30° incline bench (back against the bench) and lift the weight up and out in a Y shape. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM! After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Pause for about 1 second at the top and then allow your shoulder blades to peel apart on the way back down, under control. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Keep your triceps firmly pinned against the pad as you curl. Smooth controlled reps. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

You can use a rope or bar attachment for these, whichever you find more comfortable. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Keep your body as rigid as possible throughout the ROM. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

This can be a Barbell Back Squat, Barbell Front Squat, Pendulum Squat, Hack Squat, Belt Squat, or Smith Machine Squat. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7-8 resting ~3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Minimize contribution from your back leg! After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9 resting ~2-4 min between sets. 1 total work set
After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

If possible, place foam pads in between the outside of your knees and the pads on the machine. This will increase your range of motion on the machine. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set

1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Think about shrugging "up to your ears". Use straps, if possible. After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set
1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the cable at roughly hip height. Let your hand go slightly past your midline at the bottom of each rep to get a deep stretch on the side delt. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 1 set of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 1 total work set

Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack. After 0-1 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat (using straps can help here). After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of 9-10 resting ~1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Stick your glutes straight back as you lower the bar straight down, centered over the middle of your foot. Get a nice deep stretch at the bottom, but keep your spine neutral (don't round forward). After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 7-8 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and control the weight on the way down. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of 8-9 resting ~2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets
